scope: BuildingClass::Infiltrate on synthetic houses, building type, rules and one Super: every arm, their order, the local-player and radar-event gates of the radar event and the EVA lines. The Super has no anim and no custom charge time (+0x24 = -1).
assumptions: GameMode 1, so IsPlayer compares each house with PlayerPtr.
Both houses hold no silo storage (+0x2FC) and a capacity (+0x310) of 200, so Spend_Money never drains buildings.
substitutions: MapClass::Reset_Shroud 0x577AB0, CreateRadarEvent 0x65FA70 (answered per row) and VoxClass::PlayEVA 0x752700 are recorded stubs.
The building's vt+0x1B8 answers a fixed cell; vt+0x124 (Mark) returns.
